nom: COSRX Acne Pimple Master Patch - Original Care

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or T-zone-oily skin report frequent under-the-skin bumps and use the patches to draw out oil and gunk overnight.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry or acne-prone dry skin report the patches work without drying out the skin, though one notes needing serum or moisturizer first to avoid dryness.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination skin (dry on the forehead) reports no problems using the patches anywhere on the face.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin report no irritation from the patches, including on cystic pimples.
segments.mature: One long-time reviewer in her late 50s reports the patches still work well on an occasional blemish and heal with minimal hyperpigmentation on dark, dry, mature skin.

concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report whiteheads and under-the-skin bumps flatten, reduce in size, or disappear within a day or overnight; a few say the patches only bring pimples closer to the surface without fully resolving them, and one reviewer found them largely ineffective compared to other brands.
concerns.spots: Several reviewers report the patches pull out pus, oil, and debris visibly onto the patch, sometimes requiring manual extraction afterward or reapplication over several nights for larger or cystic spots.
concerns.redness: Many reviewers report visibly reduced redness and inflammation within a day or two; one reviewer reports her acne was still red and visible after four days of use.
concerns.oiliness: A few reviewers with oily T-zones report the patches effectively absorb excess oil and sebum from underlying pimples.
concerns.barrier: Some reviewers describe the patches as a protective barrier that prevents picking and scarring while the blemish heals, with no reported irritation even on sensitive or reactive skin.
concerns.aging: One mature reviewer reports the patches heal blemishes with minimal hyperpigmentation and no dryness on her skin.
concerns.dehydration: One reviewer reports the patch can leave the skin slightly dry unless a small amount of serum or moisturizer is applied first.

aspects.libelle: Too few medium-sized patches per sheet
Patches lift or fall off edges

extraits.texte: The first time I applied incorrectly by putting one on after I had already applied moisturizer, causing it to not work properly. Once I figured out my mistake, I applied correctly, but it still is hit or miss on whether it does what it says it'll do. Depending on what stage the pimple is at determines how well, if at all, it sucks out the gunk. Sometimes it doesn't get anything out but brings the whitehead closer to the surface. Other times it doesn't get anything at all and it looks the same as it did the night prior. I tested it out on a cystic pimple last night that has been around for far too long, and to my surprise, it somehow worked at getting some of the pus out and minimizing how large the bump was. These seem to work relatively well but you may need to apply more than once to the same pimple to get the results you really want. I noticed the super small ones haven't been much use for me, and I gravitate towards the medium and large sizes more. I also have sensitive skin and haven't noticed any irritation from using these. Other than that, I love the resealable packaging and think you get a great amount for your buck. I purchased the smaller pack as a test run but definitely plan to buy the larger option next time.

I love these! Will never buy any other kind of patch, i had this on and no one even knew it was on my face (no make up on) Fast acting, pimple/blemish was gone by the end of the day Light weight couldn't even tell it was on my face Ive been trying new make up so these have been a life saver Disclaimer I do have combo skin on the dry side (extra dry forehead) these have no problem anywhere on my skin I would give this a 4.8/5 not absolute perfect being that its so sticky its hard to carefully take off the packaging otherwise I will forever buy these

extraits.titre: K beauty staple, it's my HG!
extraits.texte: I learned about these a few years ago and now they're a staple. I'm blemish free at a young 57 yo, but I recently got a giant blemish on my chin. I washed my face gently, and added this patch for at least 24 hours. It gently brings the gunk to the surface and removes it while keeping it protected, and it's invisible. The first time I used it, it seemed like magic it worked so well at removing all the gunk. This time, it brought it to the surface, and probably needed several more hours to fully release on its own. But the patch was expired, hence my recent repurchase of these at 21 Days of Beauty. I did end up helping things along on my own, gently toned it, added another patch in case anymore gunk needed to be expelled, then finally dabbed a bit of AHA on it. It healed nicely with a minimum of hyperpigmentation on my dark skin. Sometimes I'll dab a bit of centella ampoule as well for healing. Leave it to K beauty to come up with something so gentle and effective without being in any way drying. Having dry skin and blemishes is a tricky combo for me. But they've got you covered. Love it!

extraits.titre: Great Patches, Love the Different Sizes!
extraits.texte: I was super excited to try these acne patches! I have acne-prone dry skin with mild sensitivity. I would usually use these at night time and wear them while I slept. They would stay on throughout the night which is really great! I have also used these ones under makeup and they work pretty well and in certain lights, were fairly undetectable. I also love the different sizes available! The only issue I had was sometimes there were be a sticky residue on my skin. Besides that, they worked relatively well and are some of the best patches I've tried. I would recommend! Note: I received these products free for testing purposes through Influenster.

I've been very impressed with the effectiveness of these patches. I commonly have cystic acne, and while these won't get rid of them overnight, using them for a few nights dramatically lowers the time you have to deal with them. Definitely recommend!

I received the product for free from Influenster and COSRX to try in exchange for my honest review. I am amazed at the results. I get alot of under the skin bumps in my t zones where I am most oily. I had one come up on my chin which was forming into a pimple so I put one of the smaller sized patches on after my nightly skin routine and woke up this morning to clear,smooth skin! I was hesitant to try this product as I did not think it would take away a pimple in one night but it did! They are unnoticeable, as pictured. You can easily put makeup on over if needed and no one would ever know you had a pesky pimple there! Love the different sizes to fit your needs.

I did NOT like these acne patches. They were too expensive for what you got (one small sheet of patches) and they were thick so super difficult to remove from the sheet. The sizes of the patches themselves were also annoying to deal with. They were either too big or too small. I liked the medium sized acne patches but they only had a couple of them on the sheet. As for effectiveness in getting rid of acne, I don't think they did a very good job of that... it took me 4 days of using these patches before my acne started going down and even then, it's still red and visible on my face (just flat now). I would not recommend these patches to anyone looking to try new acne treatment.
